title: EC60601: Digital Voice And Picture Communication
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Pre-requisites: EC31002 and EC31008Digital speech communication; Digital TV
communication; Characteristics of speech signals; Characteristics of picture
signals; Subjective and objective testing; Bit rates in speech and picture
communication; ITU-T recommendations for speech digitization; HDTV, Low
resolution TV and Videoconferencing requirements; Time domain waveform coding
of speech-PCM, DPCM,ADPCM, and DM; Frequency domain waveform coding of speechLTC, ATC; Parameter coding of speech-channel, format and LPC vocoders; Coding
of monochrome and colour video signals-Transform and Adaptive transform coding;
Subband coding; Vecotor quantisation; Interframe and Hybrid coding; Delayed
decision and run length coding; Effects of transmission errors; Audio and Video
conferencing; Video telephone.
